parts.name: Lens
parts.Basic_description: This is the lens of the camera, made primarily of optical glass. It is cylindrical and located at the front of the camera body.
parts.Functional_description: The lens focuses light onto the camera sensor or film, determining image clarity and zoom capability.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly for focusing or zooming, either manually or automatically.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is a shutter button made of plastic, located on the top of the camera.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to capture photos or start/stop video recording when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is a secondary control button made of plastic, located near the main shutter button.
parts.Functional_description: It may control power, mode selection, or other camera functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or slightly inward when pressed, returning to its original position afterward.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the camera, made of durable plastic, housing all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and protection for the internal electronics, lens mount, and buttons.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the foundation for all other components.
